meta.description: Machine-readable design system for the Allied Construction theme. Agents read this as the source of truth for design tokens. The CSS source of truth is src/styles/global.css. Sections opt into a color theme via data-theme="Dark" | "Neutral" (default = light); the .theme-* utilities re-color per section from CSS variables.

Neutral.note: Same ink as Default, grey background band.

colors.note: Brand teal (#00a7bd) is reserved for the logo. Sections are black / white / grey bands; text is pure black or white per theme.

displayTreatment.note: Titles use Syne 700, UPPERCASE. Applied via the .theme-title utility and the sized .theme-h1..h4 utilities.

body.note: Body copy and pretitle labels use Albert Sans, normal case.

components.btn-primary: .btn.btn-primary — filled button, inverts per theme (black on light, white on dark). Optional trailing arrow icon.
components.btn-simple: .btn.btn-simple — text-only link with trailing arrow (e.g. 'Meet Our Leadership').
components.nav-link: .nav-link — animated underline that wipes in from the left on hover (2px, currentColor).
components.fade-in: .fade-in / .is-visible — scroll-reveal (opacity + scale) toggled by IntersectionObserver; used on project cards.
components.locations-map: LocationsMap.astro — Leaflet map, CartoDB light basemap, black teardrop pins for project locations.
